title: ImageButton
summary: A clickable image: same image properties as ImageLabel plus button events (Activated, MouseButton1Click). Standard for icon buttons and custom UI controls.

explanation.whatItIs: ImageLabel + clickability. When the control IS the picture (inventory slots, emoji buttons, minimap icons).
explanation.whyItExists: Buttons that look like their function are better UX than text labels for icons.
tips: HoverImage/PressedImage give instant feedback without code
commonMistakes: MouseButton1Click on mobile-only games — use Activated
Tiny hit areas around big visuals (extend the button's Size beyond the art)

examples.title: Slot button
examples.code:
local slot = Instance.new("ImageButton")
slot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(56, 56)
slot.Image = "rbxassetid://0"   -- your icon id
slot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 50)
slot.Parent = script.Parent

slot.Activated:Connect(function()
    print("Slot clicked")
end)
